parties.petitioner: The Authorised Officer, Central Bank of India

summary: Earnest money forfeiture under SARFAESI Act; standard for forfeiture: full amount permissible if default established; earnest money as security deposit not subject to proportionality; no unjust enrichment; exception to forfeiture only in exceptional circumstances; High Court's reduction of forfeiture set aside; full forfeiture upheld.
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; High Court judgment set aside; forfeiture of entire earnest money deposit upheld.
